# scamp_volume (Data Source)

Retrieves information about an existing volume by UUID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The UUID of the volume to retrieve.

### Read-Only

- `attached_vm_id` (String) UUID of the VM the volume is attached to (null if not attached).
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the volume was created.
- `display_name` (String) Display name of the volume.
- `read_bandwidth_limit` (Number) Read bandwidth limit (MB/s).
- `read_iops_limit` (Number) Read IOPS limit.
- `sds_pool_name` (String) Name of the SDS pool.
- `size_gb` (Number) Size of the volume in GB.
- `state` (String) State of the volume.
- `storage_class_id` (Number) ID of the storage class.
- `write_bandwidth_limit` (Number) Write bandwidth limit (MB/s).
- `write_iops_limit` (Number) Write IOPS limit.
